_doc: Curated technique seeds (knowledge_architecture.md section 5), one file per area. Fields: id, level + scope (a scope node or universal), aliases (v1 / technique-DB / footer names folded in), mechanism, preconditions (predicate DSL), predicts (canonical metric -> up|down|flat|up_or_flat|down_or_flat), risks (pitfalls), states / op_classes / op_kinds gates (empty = any), slot (offered by the multi-slot agent), prior {mean, n}: a seed prior with a low pseudo-count that evidence overrides, realizations by scope (target:<key> | target:<backend>:sm_NN+ | target:<backend> | node:<id> | universal). Loaded by Ontology.seed(); scripts/seed_knowledge.py builds a knowledge.db from these files.

techniques.mechanism: tile Q/K/V through fast memory with an online softmax so the score matrix never round-trips through DRAM

realizations.how: Per (batch*head, Q tile): loop over K/V tiles in on-chip memory, S = Q K^T in registers, online softmax (m, l) update, O += P V; normalise once at the end.
As above with cp.async double-buffered K/V tiles and mma.sync for both products.

techniques.mechanism: prefix sums in blocks: an in-block scan (warp scans + a scan of warp totals), then block carries added in a second phase (or decoupled look-back)
risks: fp32 cumulative sums reorder additions vs the reference; keep per-row sequential order when the tolerance is tight

realizations.how: Rows are independent: one warp / block per row; within a row __shfl_up_sync warp scans, a shared array of warp totals, then add the carry; long rows: chunked with a running carry.
Per row, vector chunks with an in-register log-step scan (vslideup + vfadd), carry the last element between chunks.

techniques.mechanism: the input projections of all timesteps do not depend on the recurrence: compute them as one big GEMM, keep only the hidden-state GEMM per step

realizations.how: X W_ih^T for all T at once (a tiled GEMM), then the T sequential steps only do h W_hh^T + gates.

techniques.mechanism: one persistent kernel runs all timesteps, with the gate math fused and the recurrent weights / hidden state kept on chip
risks: grid-wide sync between steps (cooperative launch or one block per sequence)

realizations.how: Loop over timesteps inside one kernel; each block owns a slice of hidden units, computes its gate pre-activations, applies sigmoid / tanh and the cell update in registers, then synchronises before the next step.

techniques.mechanism: one resident block per SM loops over work tiles from a queue: no tail wave, no per-tile launch
risks: load imbalance without a dynamic queue (atomic counter)

realizations.how: Launch (number of SMs x blocks per SM) blocks; each loops: tile = atomicAdd(counter) (or a static stride) until done.
